recipes.title: Korean Popcorn Chicken with Sticky Rice (meal prep)

items.i: sesame seeds and sliced green onion

steps: Toss the diced chicken with soy sauce, black pepper and the egg until fully coated.
Put the cornflour in a large lidded container, add the chicken, seal and shake until every piece is coated.
Spread on a rack and spray with oil. Air fry at 200°C (390°F) for 10–12 minutes, or bake at 210°C (410°F) for 10–14 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Simmer the soy sauce, water, ketchup, gochujang, rice vinegar, honey and brown stevia, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Toss the crispy chicken in the glaze, then divide between 4 containers with the sticky rice. Top with sesame seeds and green onion.
recipes.notes: The creator gives 495 calories and 50 g protein per container; carbs and fat are estimated, and the rice amount is worked back from those calories.
